_comment: T4 thematic affix. Mythic+ancient only -- gates to high-tier player loot, naturally never rolls on mob equipment (mob-equipped affixes max out at uncommon/rare). Real payoff is the on-hit sky-launch effect handled in kubejs/server_scripts/affixes/affix_effects.js, NOT the raw +knockback number. Values kept moderate so the proc is what makes the affix feel earned.
